newsitem.title: UK: End-Nov German household stocks down to 62.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: End-Nov German household stocks down to 62.5 pct.

text.p: German private household stocks of heating fuel stood at about 62.5 percent of capacity at the end of November, compared to year-ago levels of 67.5 percent, German heating oil suppliers said on Thursday.
The sources said the end-November levels were down from the historical average of 66 percent capacity seen between 1980 and 1995.

Some industry sources said that in view of buying hesitancy from end-consumers over the past month because of high prices, the November level should not be seen as pointing automatically to an increase in demand in the mid-winter period.

Traders said that historically the peak storage period is around September and October, when this year the rate stood at around 65 percent in both months, compared to a historical average of 71 percent.
German household stocks are widely watched in European gas oil markets since Germany is Europe's largest consumer of middle distillates for heating fuel use.
